verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
verses.transliteration: Tab bat yadaa abee Lahabinw-wa tabb

translations.text: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verses.transliteration: Maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

translations.text: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.

verses.transliteration: Sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

translations.text: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
